systems.country_label: framework issued by MoCT/NCA, June 2026, guided by ISO/IEC 27000 and 27005; critical-infrastructure operators must run its risk assessments and report yearly to the NCA
systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Technology; National Communications Authority

note: Framework adopts ISO/IEC 27000 and 27005 to guide governance but the document does not say public bodies must comply with or be certified to them; operators must follow the framework's own process, so modelled-on, not a requirement.
